CREATE TABLE "app_item"(
 "id" integer NOT NULL,
 "company" text,
 "stored_value" integer DEFAULT 5,
 "stamp" integer,
 "computed" integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS (stored_value * 2) STORED,
 "draft" boolean,
 "deleted" text,
 PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "app_line"(
 "document_id" integer NOT NULL,
 "pos" integer NOT NULL,
 "body" text,
 PRIMARY KEY ("document_id","pos")
)

CREATE TABLE "app_note"(
 "id" integer NOT NULL,
 "doc" integer,
 "pos" integer,
 PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
 CONSTRAINT "fk_0a31326f" FOREIGN KEY ("doc", "pos") REFERENCES "app_line" ("document_id", "pos") ON UPDATE CASCADE
)
